Hi Giles,

 

I hope you are well.

 

Just contacting to update you and ask some further questions.

 

We have begun the DFM process and as expected we have had to look to supply chain for the materials at a suitable size for our proposed layout that are nonstandard size. I have requested quotes and I am awaiting the responses which may take a day or two yet as it is non-standard.

 

As you can imagine without the fully released drawings for each individual layer especially the circuits, we have some further questions for you to ensure we prepare as accurate a quote as we can.

 

If you can guide is on what/how many print layers are applied to each. Looking at the drawing and images provided I have assumed the following,

 

Top circuit

 

  • Conductive Silver (Tracks).
  • Silicone spacer dots.
  • Dielectric (at the tails).

 

Bottom Circuit

 

  • Conductive Silver Tracks.
  • Conductive Carbon Background (Black Layer).
  • Dielectric (at the tails).

                           

 Also to confirm the full assembly of both circuits is then encapsulated on top with a 150um Textured Polyester polymer film….which was not evident within the images

 

As I mentioned we are awaiting quotes from supply chain to complete our quotation so just would ask you bear with us.

 

I look forward to hearing from you.

 

Cheers

S

Subject: [EXTERNAL] Pressure Sensitive Membrane - Conductive inks on sheets

 

Good afternoon.

 

We currently import a sensitive map from America, which has two dielectric sheets with printed electronic circuits separated by silicon pimples. When sandwiched in between some thin, I assume polyurethane sheets, it acts as a pressure-sensitive mat that we would like to incorporate into our lifts and be manufactured locally in the UK.

 

What I'm inquiring is whether you have the ability to print these dielectric sheets with conductive ink on it, and in particular to have the kind of rubber-silicone pimples that allow us to build this pressure mat.

 

Please feel free to call me back to discuss further, but otherwise simply let me know whether this is a capability that you have, or if you know of any other companies in the UK that might be able to supply such sheets. We are interested in either having them made in the UK or assembling them in-house in our workshop.

 

 

Many Thanks,
